summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Site Settings, Media Management, and frontend display. All 20 backend API tests passed. Fixed React 19 strict mode error in TempleAnimations.jsx. Site Settings inputs are now editable, Audio/Video/Gallery items display correctly in admin and frontend.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed React 19 strict mode error in TempleAnimations.jsx - Math.random() was being called during render which violates React's purity rules. Changed to use seeded random function with pre-generated data outside component.
Site Settings updateField function correctly uses immutable state updates with spread operators
API response keys are correctly mapped: /api/admin/audio-tracks returns 'tracks', /api/admin/video-performances returns 'videos', /api/admin/gallery returns 'gallery'
SnapWidget integration field added to Site Settings and working correctly
seed_data_creation: Test audio track, video, and gallery items created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 reported bugs have been verified as fixed: 1) Site Settings inputs are editable - confirmed by testing Main Title field, 2) Audio tracks save and display correctly - 5 tracks shown in admin, 3) Video performances display correctly - 6 videos shown in admin, 4) Gallery items display correctly - 8 items shown in admin. SnapWidget integration field is present in Site Settings. Frontend displays all media content with 20 images and YouTube thumbnails visible.
